text: Meet. Met. I met my cousins at the park on Saturday.
Feel. Felt. I felt so tired on Sunday night.
Visit. Visited. We visited my grandmother on Sunday.
Call. Called. She called me three times on Friday.
Stay home. Stayed. I stayed home all Saturday and I loved it.
Miss out. I missed out on the party. Everyone went.
Have a great time. We had a great time at the concert.
A piece of cake. The maths test? A piece of cake.

You look terrible. What did you do this weekend?
Thanks. I stayed home the whole time. I watched a whole season.
A whole season? In two days?
I felt fine on Saturday. On Sunday I felt like a ghost.
You missed out, then. We met at the skate park on Saturday.
Nobody called me!
I called you twice. Your phone was off.
Ah. That explains it. Was it good?
We had a great time. And then we visited my aunt and ate everything in her kitchen.
Okay, next weekend I am charging my phone.
Last weekend I stayed home and watched a series.
On Saturday I met my friends at the mall.
We had a great time.

And you? What did you do?

Okay, so you will not believe my Saturday. We planned everything: the cinema, four o clock, the three of us. I left home at half past three and the bus never came. Never. I waited twenty-five minutes and then I walked. I arrived forty minutes late and the film had already started, so I did not go in. I sat outside and I felt so stupid. But then they came out, we walked to the pizza place, and honestly? That was the best part of the day. Anyway. What did you do?

Good morning. A quick word about last week's school trip. Sixty students went, and everything ran on time, which surprised all of us. In the morning we walked around the old town. In the afternoon we visited the museum and had lunch in the park. Nobody got lost, and nobody lost a phone, which is a first. Two students left jackets on the bus, so come and get them. And we still need the photos. Please send them before Friday. Thank you.
